customManagers.description: Track plugin source.ref values in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as github-releases

packageRules.description: Label trusted internal plugin sources. Replace <YOUR_ORG> with your org name; add additional trusted orgs as needed.
Gate external (non-trusted) plugin sources on dashboard approval
Major version bumps always require manual review
Auto-merge disabled by default. Enterprise operators enable per-rule (e.g., trusted-source + minor/patch) once Renovate operations have been validated against the operator's CI and review policies.
